datasetNotice: Developer-authored expected labels, not an expert gold standard. This pilot checks retrieval of predefined source phrases, not scientific review accuracy or whether evidence supports a generated answer. Chinese questions retain English source terms and do not establish general cross-language retrieval. No expected-no-hit cases are claimed.
execution: local lexical retrieval; no model requests or model cost; network only for explicitly requested publisher XML download
gateMeaning: 只判定本份开发者预设、材料完整性及原文切片校验是否满足；不能认证专家审查、模型推断或一般真实论文准确率。

recallAt8.definition: 仅在成功获取并验证预设的材料中，top-8片段完整包含开发者预设短引文的微平均召回；失败材料与非法预设另行计数，不是专家评审或一般论文准确率。
